messages:
maya: Heads-up — nightly-refresh-watcher failed again on model-refresh-2026-03. Job timed out at ~25m. Logs: https://logs.redwood.ai/ab12cd (watchdog: timed out waiting for worker). Anyone seen this lately?

jonathan: Ugh. Seen similar when the controller restarts mid-cron. Can you paste the pod logs? Paging @liam for infra context.

maya: Pasted last 200 lines:
```
kubectl logs model-refresh-2026-03-178 --tail=200
...
watchdog: waiting for workers
ERROR: Failed to fetch model artifacts: timed out after 120s
...
```

liam: I spun the controller once, but the cron-runner still scheduled overlapping runs. Looks like the watcher doesn't do leader election/lock correctly. Could be a race on the lockfile.

natalie: We enabled leader election env var for the cron-controller last month but I don’t think the watcher job picks it up. Quick fix: add a lightweight lock wrapper. Longer term: migrate to leader election library.

ci-bot: Re-run requested by liam. Command: `/rerun job=model-refresh-2026-03 --focus=watcher`. Status: queued.

jonathan: Also noticed the post-refresh benchmark job spikes memory. If fetch times increase, artifact size might be growing. Recommend bisecting manifests to find when artifact sizes jumped. Quick bisect script: `./scripts/bisect_refresh.sh --since=2026-02-20 --job model-refresh`

maya: Starting bisect on a dev node now, will post progress. Please hold merging to main on model-manifests until I finish.

liam: FYI I saw one pod OOMKilled: model-fetcher with 1.5Gi limit. We can bump limits in the short term or switch to streaming downloads to avoid buffering entire artifacts. Opened PR #812 with a quick bump.

natalie: Linking PR #812. Bumping might mask the root cause (artifact blowup). Prefer streaming + lock approach.

maya: OK — I'll try adding streaming + a file lock around the fetch. Thanks all :pray: 

ci-bot: Rerun started. run id: 98765. Will post status updates here.

sre-bot: Note: scheduled maintenance occurred in us-west-2 at 02:15 UTC which overlapped the cron window. Leader election may have been briefly disrupted.

jonathan: Good catch @sre-bot. Suggest we shift the cron to 03:00 UTC while we stabilize so it doesn't hit the maintenance window.

maya: Done — bumped CronJob schedule to 03:00 UTC in git (cron/refresh-cron.yaml). Pushed commit 4f9b2a3. I'll watch tonight and report results in the morning.

liam: Thanks. If the bisect points to a manifest change that increased artifact size, I'll open a rollback PR.

maya: Closing the loop for now — if rerun passes I'll mark flaky=false and file follow-ups for streaming + lock. Will update this thread tomorrow AM with rerun/bisect results.
